Economy · India

Akasa Air plans UDAN scheme flights, expands fleet

Akasa Air has announced plans to operate flights under the government's UDAN scheme, indicating a strategy to expand its reach. The airline also expects steady fleet growth through 2032. This comes as the company took delivery of its ninth Boeing 737 MAX aircraft, which arrived in India after a multi-stop journey from Seattle.
